Per-unit identification weight column for one estimand

Source: R/variance.R
dot-estimand_weight.Rd

Builds the per-unit identification weight column b for one estimand:

  • marginal: \(b_i = wts_i\)

  • non-marginal: \(b_i = wts_i \cdot 1(W_i = w) / P_\phi(W_i = w)\) (Theorem 3.6(b))

Usage

.estimand_weight(spec, weights1, weights0, W_Y, p1_own, p0_own)

Arguments

spec

one specification from .po_specs.

weights1, weights0

per-regime identification weights.

W_Y

0/1 vector of individual-level treatments.

p1_own, p0_own

per-unit own-treatment probabilities under phi_1 and phi_0.

Value

A numeric weight vector.

Examples

spec <- generalClusterExp:::.po_specs()$Ybar_w1_phi1   # Ybar(1, phi1)
W_Y <- c(1, 0, 1, 0)
## = weights1 * 1(W = 1) / P_phi1(W = 1)
generalClusterExp:::.estimand_weight(spec,
  weights1 = rep(1, 4), weights0 = rep(1, 4), W_Y = W_Y,
  p1_own = rep(0.5, 4), p0_own = rep(0.2, 4))
#> [1] 2 0 2 0
